title: Power Sliding Door Failures and Latch Problems
caption:
🚐 Power sliding door acting up on your Honda Odyssey?
If the door won’t latch (bounces back open) or you get constant beeping + a “door open” warning, the rear latch assembly is often the culprit. Other common causes: binding rollers/tracks, a tired actuator motor, or a flaky door control module.
Repair cost can vary widely depending on what failed—expect roughly $150–$1,200+ (DIY vs. parts + labor).
